artworks.prompt: Real night photograph: a red paper lantern glowing, hanging from a thin black wire that enters from the top edge, wet with raindrops, magenta and cyan neon reflections on its sides. No shadow.
Real night photograph: an open clear plastic umbrella, tilted, covered in raindrops that catch pink and cyan neon light, white handle. Floating, nobody holding it. No shadow.

Real night photograph: a small glowing neon sign shaped like a steaming noodle bowl, hot pink and cyan tubes, hanging from two short wires from the top edge, raindrops on the tubes. No letters. No shadow.
Photographic, high detail, natural, like a crisp telephoto nature photograph: a crow in flight at night in rain, glossy black feathers catching magenta and cyan neon reflections. No shadow.
